name: Circuit of the Americas
summary: layout, length, direction, elevation (lidar) and the Turn 1 climb all match; only cosmetic / minor items

layout.gameLayout: Grand Prix Circuit 2012-present (20 turns), the layout of every 2012-2026 United States GP
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API (maps.mail.ru mirror), cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/

direction.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_of_the_Americas: "one of only a handful on the Formula One 2012 calendar to be run counter-clockwise"; OSM oneway raceway ways agree over 9435 m, 0 m against

pit.limitSource: FIA 2025 Formula 1 Sporting Regulations, Issue 5 (2025-04-30), art. 34.7: "A speed limit of 80km/h will be imposed in the pit lane during the whole Competition. However, this limit may be amended by the Race Director" (cache/fia/fia_2025_formula_1_sporting_regulations_-_issue_5_-_2025-04-30.txt)

elevation.demUsedForReference: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM (1 m lidar; ImageServer getSamples)
elevation.gameSource: USGS 3DEP via EPQS along the dataset centreline, DTM filters

famousFeatures.real: lidar 13 % over 50 m / 12.4 % over 100 m at s 250 m

famousFeatures.feature: drop from Turn 1 into the esses

famousFeatures.real: lidar 30.8 m along the OSM centreline (151.1 m ASL at s 4898, 181.9 m at Turn 1, s 340)
famousFeatures.verdict: ok against the lidar; the published 41 m is not reachable on the track surface (already noted in tools/build-tracks.mjs)

banking.method: lidar heights at +-4 m across the OSM centreline every 10 m; tilt = atan((hLeft - hRight) / 8 m)

findings.game: curvature-derived banking 1.6-5.4 deg (median per corner, inside lower) on all 20 corners; Turn 1 5.4 deg
findings.real: lidar cross-slope (+-4 m): Turn 1 is genuinely cambered 4.3 deg (max 4.6); every other corner shows only the ~1.4 deg drainage cross-fall (straights median 1.4 deg), and Turn 4, Turn 6 fall away from the apex (-1.5 / -1.4 deg, off-camber) where the game banks them 2.9 / 2.4 deg
findings.proposedFix: keep Turn 1 (derived value is close); optionally replace the derived banking by the measured cross-slope profile (profile.rows column realTiltDeg, every 10 m) or scale the derived banking down for this circuit (needs a per-track factor in js/track.js)
sources: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM, 1 m lidar (public domain): https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer (getSamples), acquisition dates from https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json?...&includeDate=true
game data: tracks-data.js + js/track.js built in node (devtests/track-audit/americas/game.js -> out/game-<id>.json)

findings.game: no structure over the track (scenery-data.js has no man_made=bridge polygon for us-2012)
findings.real: three pedestrian bridges span the track: OSM ways 191582144 (s 815.2 m, after Turn 2), 1285657865 (s 1843.3 m, Turn 10), 191582102 (s 4176.2 m, Turn 17); two service / foot tunnels pass under the start straight (s 124-132 m) and one under s 3210 m (invisible from the car)
findings.proposedFix: add footbridge decks at those three crossings (scenery: a deck like addBridge() at >= 6.5 m clearance); OSM ways are linear (highway=footway, bridge=yes, layer 1), so build-scenery would need to buffer them to a ~4 m wide polygon
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API (maps.mail.ru mirror), cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/

findings.real: OSM way 514836373 "Pit Lane" (949 m) on the left: from s -698.8 m (between Turn 19 and Turn 20, on the inside) to s +311 m (it rejoins at Turn 1); limit 80 km/h
findings.proposedFix: side and limit are right; the lane is ~450 m shorter than the real one (js/track.js PIT_REACH = 250 m each way). If longer lanes are wanted: pitLane {entry: [30.1353383, -97.6413928], exit: [30.1300873, -97.6370612]} (needs js/track.js support)

However, this limit may be amended by the Race Director" (cache/fia/fia_2025_formula_1_sporting_regulations_-_issue_5_-_2025-04-30.txt)

findings.real: OSM node 7909207460 raceway=start-finish is 22.6 m before it

proposedCorrection.elevation: keep usgs3dep (lidar 2017; game rms 0.15 m vs lidar along OSM, grades within 1 pp)

profile.note: s from the game line; real = lidar on the OSM foot point (30 m median); game = js/track.js sample y; tilt = lidar cross-slope (deg, + = left higher); gBank = game bank (deg, same sign)
